title: Property development homepage wireframe with location, homes and enquiry pages
what: Clickable HTML wireframe of a property development site: homepage buyer journey linking location, homes and enquiry pages, plus a WordPress page plan and lead-routing rules.
shows: Homepage calls to action prefill the enquiry form; homes table filters by availability; form validates and shows a routing result; WordPress page tree and fields as JSON.
checks: all internal links resolve to generated pages
available homes counted two ways match
lead validation and routing give expected results
done: Homepage wireframe with two calls to action
Linked location, homes and enquiry pages
Enquiry form validation and demo routing
remaining: Branding, imagery and copy from production materials
WordPress theme build and hosting install
Real form delivery and agreed lead routing
limits: Synthetic plots and placeholder content; grey-box wireframe, not a styled WordPress theme; forms send nothing.
